description: Ravfia Coin (RFCN) is the presentation name of the Ravfia Lending settlement token on Solana devnet. Token details are unchanged from its issuance as Ravfia USD (RUSD): mint RavjJ8xMrGpZbfs6XzRf8V5fg2LXjMwL3YT6aTWqoeV, 6 decimals, total supply 1,000,000. Ravfia is the lender of record; the token is used for loan disbursement and servicing through the loan_servicing program. Devnet only - no real funds, not audited, no live lending.
